# Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)

Powder bed fusion (SLS and HP Multi Jet Fusion) fuses nylon or TPU powder layer by layer. The unfused powder holds the part up, so nothing needs support and no print orientation is asked for; instead, hollows need escape holes for the powder, and thick or flat sections warp as they cool. Thresholds follow the Formlabs Fuse, HP MJF, Xometry, Materialise and HLH design guides, for PA12 unless a material says otherwise.

**Process family:** Powder Bed 3D Printing. Powder bed fusion (SLS, MJF). Thresholds from material data. The powder holds the part up, so no print orientation is needed.

## What you set up

Nothing: pick the part, the process and a material, and run.

Sorted by [criticality](../../concepts/criticality.md). The values are the Default material's; the materials below change some of them.

| [Escape Holes](../rules/min-escape-hole-diameter.md) | High | Aim for: 5 mm · At least: 3.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "5 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "At least 3.5 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |
| [Minimum Gap](../rules/min-print-gap.md) | High | Aim for: 1.0 mm · At least: 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "1 mm recommended gap between walls")<br>At least: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "0.5 mm minimum gap between walls") |
| [Maximum Wall Thickness](../rules/max-wall-thickness.md) | Medium | Aim for: 5 mm · At most: 7 mm | Aim for: Published, [3DPrintUK](../../citations/bibliography.md#threedprintuk-sls "5 mm recommended maximum")<br>At most: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "Hollow walls over 7 mm") |
| [Pin Diameter](../rules/min-pin-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 1.5 mm · At least: 0.8 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "1.5 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "0.8 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |
| [Pin Slenderness](../rules/max-pin-slenderness.md) | Medium | Aim for: 10× its diameter · At most: 20× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Formlabs' resin wire figures, about 20 diameters") |
| [Printed Hole Depth](../rules/max-printed-hole-depth.md) | Medium | Aim for: 3× its diameter · At most: 8× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-lspc "Resin's Xometry figures. HLH and Fast Radius say deep and blind holes trap powder, without a figure"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls), [Fast Radius](../../citations/bibliography.md#fast-radius-mjf) |
| [Printed Hole Diameter](../rules/min-printed-hole-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 1.5 mm · At least: 1.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-sls "1.5 mm"), [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf)<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "1 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |
| [Sealed Cavity](../rules/sealed-cavity.md) | Medium | If detected: Warning | Published, [Raise3D](../../citations/bibliography.md#raise3d-sls "A warning, not an error: powder can be left in a sealed hollow on purpose") |
| [Wall Thickness Transition](../rules/max-wall-thickness-variation.md) | Medium | Aim for: 25% of the thicker wall · At most: 50% of the thicker wall | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "Both advise even walls and smooth transitions, without a figure. Looser than molding's 15% / 25%"), [HP](../../citations/bibliography.md#hp-mjf) |
| [Large Flat Face](../rules/max-flat-face-area.md) | Low | Aim for: 10,000 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "Both advise against large flat faces, without a figure. 10,000 mm² is a 100 mm square"), [Stratasys](../../citations/bibliography.md#stratasys-sls) |
| [Long Thin Part](../rules/max-part-aspect-ratio.md) | Low | Aim for: 10× its width | Published, [HP](../../citations/bibliography.md#hp-mjf "Avoid parts over 10 times longer than wide") |

## Materials (5)

Each material changes only the values it needs to; everything else comes from the Default material. You can add your own materials in the Process Library.

| Material | Category | Values that differ from Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| PA12 (SLS) | Polyamide | Nothing: all Default values |
| PA12 (MJF) | Polyamide | [Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md): Aim for: 1.5 mm · At least: 0.5 mm |
| PA11 | Polyamide | Nothing: all Default values |
| PA12 Carbon-filled | Filled Polyamide | [Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md): Aim for: 2.5 mm · At least: 2.0 mm |
| TPU | Elastomer | [Escape Holes](../rules/min-escape-hole-diameter.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At least: 10 mm<br>[Maximum Wall Thickness](../rules/max-wall-thickness.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At most: 20 mm |
